title: Detector Signal
description: The atomic, deterministic output of a single detector run over canonical data. A Lead aggregates one or more Signals (see lead.schema.json). Signals are facts about the data ('this detector fired'), not judgments. See docs/detection/rules.md.

detector_id.description: Which detector in docs/detection/rules.md produced this.

entity_id.description: The entity/provider/invoice this signal is about.

source_ids.description: Source record IDs (invoice UUIDs, transaction IDs) the claim is computed from.
